episodes.198557: Heavy rain led to river flooding on the Ouachita River at the sites of Thatcher Lock and Dam and Camden in late December.
episodes.198705: Heavy rain led to river flooding on the Black River at Pocahontas in late December.

events.narrative: River flooding occurred on the Ouachita River at Thatcher Lock and Dam in late December and remained in minor flood stage into early January in which the crest at this site also occurred in early January.

River flooding occurred on the Ouachita River at Camden in late December and remained in minor flood stage into early January with the crest of the river occurring in minor flood stage in early January.

River flooding occurred on the Black River at Pocahontas in late December and continued into early January; however, the crest at this site took place on December 31st at 0115. The river at this site remained in minor flood stage for the duration of the river flooding.
